scope: K14 bounded vision sub-agent offline core only. No real visual model, paid call, device, account, tool, HTTP route or migration. D0-D5 stay undecided; default remains offline stub.

reference.adaptation: Studied the reference's one-shot, stateless, text-only vision sub-call, 60-frame cap and order-preserving subsampling. V2 independently implements a stricter offline core: canonical registered image metadata, 1-240 raw ids -> <=60 model-visible frames including both ends, per-frame 16MiB and per-call 64MiB caps, fixed focus prompts that mark frames as untrusted data and forbid tools, one complete bounded text reply, no master transcript/memory/persona/storage writes, explicit errors and no replay. No provider SDK, API key, prompt or network code copied; no real call made.

delivered: domain/visual_subagent.py: normalize_task (strip, 1-4000 chars, reject C0/control and lone surrogates), normalize_focus (ui/text/diagram/general), normalize_frame_ids (1-240 canonical unique UUIDs), VisualFrame (ImageInfo metadata validation, optional timestamp finite/non-negative, content length must equal registered bytes), select_frames (>60 -> 60 evenly spaced indices including first/last, strictly increasing and unique), build_request (fixed SYSTEM_PROMPTS, per-call 64MiB total cap), validate_reply (no tool calls, completion_reason must be stop, summary 1-4000 text) and prompt_for

application/visual_subagent.py: VisualSubagentService over injected DatabasePort/VisualFrameSource/VisualModel; parent run + model authorization asserted before the frame source and model; source must return exactly the requested frames in order; one call with a 120s timeout; one active call per (agent, run) and a global semaphore of 4; caller cancellation cancels the actual call and waits for its cleanup; close waits for actual pending tasks; zero db.write and zero memory/persona/delivery writes; result contains only text/frames/focus/model/cost_micro/input_tokens/output_tokens

20 new regressions: 8 domain nodes (task/focus/frame-id bounds, short/long burst ordering and both ends, frame metadata/content mismatch, fixed prompts + total byte cap, reply validity, prompt safety) and 12 service nodes (success one-call with no frame metadata leak, bad input before auth/source/model, duplicate run busy, global concurrency <=4, timeout/provider failure no retry, invalid reply no execution, cancellation cleanup, closed/authority/budget paths, source error/order, real SQLite parent-run authorization with zero writes)
